‘Catastrophic’ flooding sets off dozens of rescues, inundates homes and businesses in North Georgia and southern Tennessee
items.brief: Historic flooding inundated homes and businesses in North Georgia and southern Tennessee, leading to dozens of water rescues and evacuations.

items.title: Trump’s arch is poised for final approval two days after the president’s election drubbing
items.brief: A final vote to approve President Donald Trump’s proposed triumphal arch on Thursday is poised to kick off a fresh round of legal wrangling as efforts to stop its construction intensify through the courts .

items.title: Stocks plunge as midterm results send AI trade into a tailspin
items.brief: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite plunged by as much as 5.7% Thursday as investors weighed whether Democrats’ gains in the midterm elections could lead to a slowdown in the massive data center buildout.

items.title: Harmeet Dhillon, who ran the Justice Department’s Civil Rights division, resigns
items.brief: Harmeet Dhillon has resigned from her post as the head of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, making her the first senior official to leave the administration since the midterms.

items.title: Winning ticket drawn in New Jersey for $847 million Powerball jackpot
